change_summary: Promoted a runtime-only sizing result into production: Healthcare breakout signals 20-65 trading days before earnings now keep 25% of the current risk budget. Added a targeted unit test and saved the runtime screen plus post-promotion fixed-window reproduction. No entry, exit, ranking, LLM, C strategy, or slot-allocation logic changed.

delta_metrics.gate4_basis: Accepted because the 0.25x point improved EV and Sharpe in two validation windows, was strict-null in the dominant late window, and reduced old_thin drawdown. The adjacent 20-70 variant was rejected because it harmed late_strong, so the rule stays narrow.

hypothesis: After the accepted A+B residual allocation stack, remaining Healthcare breakout leakage may be event-distance related rather than another repeat of the rejected deep-pullback screen. De-risking `breakout_long | Healthcare | 20 <= days_to_earnings <= 65` at partial size should improve EV in validation windows without touching entries, exits, LLM, C strategy, or existing accepted sizing rules.

llm_metrics.blocker_relation: LLM soft ranking remains blocked by candidate-level replay coverage, so this run used deterministic A+B residual allocation instead of changing LLM responsibilities.

market_regime_summary.late_strong: slow-melt bull with zero qualifying 20-65 DTE Healthcare breakout exposure; 20-70 would include a 67-DTE LLY winner
market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull with one qualifying Healthcare breakout candidate
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak tape with one qualifying Healthcare breakout candidate

next_retry_requires: Do not widen this into all Healthcare breakouts or 20-70 DTE Healthcare breakouts
Do not retry Healthcare deep-pullback pct_from_52w_high screens without a genuinely new discriminator
Future Healthcare residual work needs a fresh audited cluster outside this accepted DTE sleeve
notes: This was alpha_search, not bug repair. It changes one independent causal variable: a narrow Healthcare breakout event-distance risk multiplier. Main risk is under-sizing rare Healthcare breakout winners close to the 65-DTE boundary; the failed 20-70 screen is why the rule was not widened.

rejected_adjacent_variants.20_70_0_25: damaged late_strong EV by cutting the 67-DTE LLY winner
rejected_adjacent_variants.50_65_0_25: positive only where exposed but lacked mid-window exposure
